# FLUI

> A Flutter-inspired declarative UI framework for Rust: five trees — immutable `View` → `Element` (lifecycle, reconciliation) → `RenderObject` (layout, paint, hit-test) → `Layer` (retained compositing), with `Semantics` alongside for accessibility — Flutter's box and sliver layout protocols, and a `wgpu` renderer. Pre-release: the `flui` CLI (`flui-cli`) is on crates.io, and the framework crates build from a git clone or the `v0.1.0` tag (`MIT OR Apache-2.0`, MSRV 1.98).

FLUI takes inspiration from Flutter — the tree model, the lifecycle ordering, and the layout/paint/hit-test protocol start there — while structure, mechanisms, and code style are designed for Rust: type-safe child arity (`Leaf`/`Single`/`Optional`/`Variable`) checked at compile time, `Result` instead of exceptions, field-granular inherited dependencies, presentation capabilities that live on `LifecycleContext` and so are acquired only in `init_state`/`did_change_dependencies`, never in `build` (ADR-0078), and per-window `UiRealm`s. Flutter is not an oracle it must match: FLUI diverges wherever the result is better, and its own tests pin the behavior it ships. See `NOTICE` for the Flutter attribution.

## Writing a view

An app is a `View` that builds other views — the widget layer drives the whole
pipeline (element tree → render objects → layout → paint → `wgpu`):

```rust
//! examples/widgets_gallery.rs (excerpt)
use flui::prelude::*;
// `column!`/`row!` are imported explicitly (not via the prelude glob) to shadow
// std's same-named macros.
use flui::widgets::{column, row};

/// A solid colour square — a small reusable builder returning a concrete
/// `View` so it slots into the `row!` tuple sequence.
fn swatch(color: Color) -> ColoredBox {
    ColoredBox::new(color).child(SizedBox::square(64.0))
}

/// A circular colour avatar: a coloured box clipped to an inscribed oval.
fn avatar(color: Color) -> ClipOval {
    ClipOval::new().child(swatch(color))
}

/// A half-faded circular avatar, showing the `Opacity` paint effect.
fn faded_avatar(color: Color) -> Opacity {
    Opacity::new(0.4).child(avatar(color))
}

/// The gallery root: a dark padded surface with a title, a row of circular
/// avatars, a faded row, and a centred "card".
#[derive(Clone, Debug, StatelessView)]
pub struct Gallery;

impl StatelessView for Gallery {
    fn build(&self, _ctx: &dyn BuildContext) -> impl IntoView {
        Container::new()
            .color(Color::rgb(18, 18, 24))
            .padding(EdgeInsets::all(24.0))
            .alignment(Alignment::TOP_LEFT)
            .child(Column::new(column![
                Text::new("FLUI widget gallery"),
                SizedBox::height(16.0),
                Row::new(row![
                    avatar(Color::rgb(229, 57, 53)),
                    SizedBox::width(12.0),
                    avatar(Color::rgb(30, 136, 229)),
                    SizedBox::width(12.0),
                    avatar(Color::rgb(67, 160, 71)),
                ]),
                SizedBox::height(12.0),
                Row::new(row![
                    faded_avatar(Color::rgb(229, 57, 53)),
                    SizedBox::width(12.0),
                    faded_avatar(Color::rgb(30, 136, 229)),
                    SizedBox::width(12.0),
                    faded_avatar(Color::rgb(67, 160, 71)),
                ]),
                SizedBox::height(24.0),
                Container::new()
                    .color(Color::rgb(38, 38, 48))
                    .padding(EdgeInsets::all(16.0))
                    .child(Center::new().child(Text::new("centered in a card"))),
            ]))
    }
}

fn main() {
    run_app(Gallery);
}
```

A stateless view is `#[derive(Clone, StatelessView)]` plus `impl StatelessView for T { fn build(&self, ctx: &dyn BuildContext) -> impl IntoView }`; a stateful one names its state with `impl StatefulView for T { type State = S; fn create_state(&self) -> S }` and implements `ViewState<T>` on `S`. Inherited data is published with `InheritedView` and read with `ctx.depend_on::<T>()`. The compiler error for a missing impl names the exact derive or impl to write.

## For contributors and agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the guide every agent runtime loads — design stance, code navigation, build and CI commands, definition of done.
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): the dependency-ordered milestones toward beta and what lands next.
- [Panic policy](docs/PANIC-POLICY.md): `expect("BUG: …")` for invariants, `Result` for everything else.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): planning a large change, git hygiene; `cargo xtask check-changed` is the pre-PR check.
